R4: four entries (wellness trends, care circle for someone living alone, activity and recovery, glucose monitoring support) use identical markup and two sentences each, of comparable length. There are no badges and no calls to action. The diabetes title is shortened to "Glucose monitoring support", but its body names people living with diabetes, so this is acceptable.

R6/R7/S3/S4: the new copy contains no present-tense glucose capability claim. It has no insulin, treatment, therapy, dose, diagnosis, cure or outcome language, and no release or delivery of any substance.

Whether all five reviews are counted and reviewer-design has judged the section is for later stations and the run verdict, not for this review.
